notes.title: Speedrunner update!
notes.notes:
We are including in the game package the original game DOS files alongside DosBox that were previously available.

You should find the new folder under your game installation directory.
For Windows: \Speedrun\Windows you can launch the game with LaunchLBA1.bat
For Mac: \Speedrun\Mac\Contents\MacOS you can launch the game with the Launcher script

Happy speedruns, and thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
We are super happy to announce that the updated version of Twinsen's Little Big Adventure Classic is now available on Steam!

[h2]The content of the update
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Language select in menu
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud Saving
[*] Controller Support
[*] Input remapping
[*] New Game+
[*] Windowed Support
[*] [b]Hit by walls toggle on/off[/b]
[/list]

Have fun!
